scope: GTK product host: shelf, import, organize, reading, annotation and account surfaces observed through AT-SPI with real X11 keystrokes

checks.name: shelf_tab_order_follows_visual_order

press Tab and compare the focus order with the element extents reported by AT-SPI
checks.minimal_fix: create the row in visual order: call gtk_box_pack_end for the more button before the details button in reader.c, so the focus chain agrees with the drawn order

checks.name: tab_cycle_elements_named
checks.expected: every element that takes keyboard focus exposes a non-empty accessible name
reproduction: show the shelf with F2
press Tab through one complete cycle and read the name of the FOCUSED element after each press
checks.minimal_fix: the focusable element is the GtkScrolledWindow the host wraps each list in; GTK leaves its accessible unnamed while it still takes focus, so name it in reader.c: atk_object_set_name(gtk_widget_get_accessible(gtk_widget_get_ancestor(image, GTK_TYPE_SCROLLED_WINDOW)), "Page") and the same for the shelf, notes, organizer group and member lists

checks.name: shelf_tab_order_cycles_without_trap

checks.name: collections_dialog_identity

reproduction: open the organizer from the shelf more menu with the keyboard

checks.minimal_fix: GTK_DIALOG_MODAL is already requested, but GTK never moves focus into the dialog: add gtk_widget_grab_focus(collections.types) (or collections.groups) after gtk_widget_show_all in collections_open(), as metadata_present() and accounts_open() already do

checks.name: collections_dialog_controls_named

gaps: Orca or any real screen reader speech output (no speech capture, no reader build)

AT-SPI live-region / announcement semantics: the GTK3 host marks no live region and the registry delivered no object:announcement event, so automatic announcement of the status text is not established either way
Braille display output and BRLTTY integration
Visible focus ring, contrast and theme rendering (WCAG 1.4.3/1.4.11/2.4.7)

Password-field presentation beyond the ATK role: the audited entry reports the password-text role and the audit measures what its text exports, but how a screen reader masks or announces a secret field is not covered
IME composition, caret browsing and selection announcement for the rendered page image
Network-backed account scan states (preparing, scanning, cancel, retry) because this audit runs offline against a local library only
Non-GTK hosts: Windows, Apple and Android surfaces are outside this package
Event coalescing and AT-SPI cache latency under a large library
